payload.title: Operator command to reconcile a wedged claimed command
payload.description: A worker that claims a publication command and dies without a terminal receipt leaves the job running; the run then refuses all machine decides with run_busy and the queue message lands in the DLQ. Add python -m decision_flywheel.command_recovery diagnose|reconcile: owner and fence must match, dry-run by default (--apply writes), audit record stored as the job result, refuses on any recorded result or provider-outcome evidence, deletes only the matching DLQ message. Docs in docs/s3-cloud-storage.md. First use: job bf25e156 (wrong provider key).
